name: Online Marketplace and Gig-Economy Platform Misuse
description: Online marketplaces, freelance and ride or delivery platforms offer payments between strangers and large seller or worker populations. Criminals use fake listings, collusive purchases, refund cycling or fake workers to launder funds, receive scam proceeds or rent out accounts. Platforms see anomalies in seller behaviour and payout flows.

sources.text: FATF, Opportunities and Challenges of New Technologies for AML/CFT (2021)
FATF, Illicit Financial Flows from Cyber-Enabled Fraud (2023)

exposure.rationale: Marketplace and gig platforms with seller payouts, refund and chargeback cycling, vouchers and account rental; platforms act as PSPs/merchants.

indicators.name: Collusive purchases between related buyer and seller accounts
indicators.canon: Collusive purchases between related buyer and seller accounts
indicators.desc: Accounts sharing devices or funding sources transact with each other to create revenue.
indicators.ctx: Accounts sharing devices or funding sources transact with each other to create revenue.

indicators.name: Sales of high-value items with no shipping or delivery evidence
indicators.canon: Sales of high-value items with no shipping or delivery evidence
indicators.desc: Orders marked complete without tracking, or delivered to unrelated addresses.
indicators.ctx: Orders marked complete without tracking, or delivered to unrelated addresses.

indicators.name: Refund and chargeback cycling
indicators.desc: Unusual refund or chargeback volumes or cycles relative to sales.
indicators.ctx: Repeated purchase and refund flows to move value between accounts.

indicators.name: Newly registered seller reaching high sales immediately
indicators.canon: Newly established customer with rapid high-value activity
indicators.desc: A recently formed customer with little history or track record quickly records large turnover or trades in high-value or restricted goods.
indicators.ctx: Rapid revenue growth for new accounts with sparse listings or reviews.

indicators.name: Gig worker account operated by someone else
indicators.canon: Account controlled or used by someone other than the holder
indicators.desc: Signs that a third party holds the card, PIN, credentials or device, or that funds and activity belong to someone other than the named holder.
indicators.ctx: Mismatched face, device or location against the verified worker.

indicators.name: Payouts to bank accounts in third-party names
indicators.canon: Payout to account not matching verified identity or declared beneficiary
indicators.desc: Payouts or disbursements are directed to bank accounts, cards or wallets that do not match the verified customer or declared beneficiary.
indicators.ctx: Seller payout accounts do not match verified identity.

indicators.name: Listings for services priced at nonsensical levels
indicators.canon: Listings for services priced at nonsensical levels
indicators.desc: Listings use extreme or placeholder prices likely used to move amounts.
indicators.ctx: Listings use extreme or placeholder prices likely used to move amounts.

indicators.name: Large volumes of gift cards or vouchers sold or purchased
indicators.canon: Bulk purchase or sale of cards or vouchers
indicators.desc: Large volumes of prepaid cards or gift cards are purchased or sold.
indicators.ctx: Gift-card heavy activity that is cashed out through marketplaces.

indicators.name: Account rental or resale signals
indicators.desc: Credential changes, new device and region shifts for an established seller.
indicators.ctx: Credential changes, new device and region shifts for an established seller.

indicators.name: Buyers directed off-platform to pay
indicators.desc: Messaging encourages payment via transfer or crypto outside platform protections.
indicators.ctx: Messaging encourages payment via transfer or crypto outside platform protections.
